phases.name: Foundation
phases.goal: Establish public-safe structure, architecture narrative, project controls, and mock-first guardrails.

phases.name: AWS GenAI MVP
phases.goal: Add a mock GenAI gateway and AWS-first integration shape without live cloud calls.

phases.name: Platform Controls
phases.goal: Add policy, approval, audit, and control-plane schemas.

phases.name: RAG Governance
phases.goal: Document and prototype governed retrieval and data-access patterns with synthetic examples.

phases.name: EKS Release Engineering
phases.goal: Add Kubernetes, Helm, Argo CD, and EKS release engineering examples.

phases.name: AI-assisted DevSecOps
phases.goal: Show how AI-assisted delivery can preserve review, CI, and security controls.

phases.name: AI Traffic Gateway Research
phases.goal: Explore governance for agent, tool, workflow, retrieval, and data-access traffic.

phases.name: LLMOps / GPU Stretch
phases.goal: Reserve future space for evaluation, LLMOps, and GPU sandbox patterns.

tracks.name: AI Traffic Gateway and Kubernetes-native Agent Runtime Research

documentationCompleteness.notes: Foundation docs exist; deeper phase docs remain future work.

demoReadiness.notes: No runnable demo beyond mock script placeholders.

publicSafetyCompliance.notes: Synthetic-only boundary, ignored private folder, and prompt-log separation are documented.

securityGovernance.notes: Controls are described but not implemented.

finopsObservability.notes: FinOps and observability concepts exist; no runtime telemetry yet.

gaps.gap: No policy schema or approval workflow implementation yet.
No governed retrieval or data-egress example yet.
No runtime token telemetry, dashboards, or traces yet.
No end-to-end mock demo script has been implemented.
Markdown dashboards are manually maintained instead of generated from status.json.
